#{id}
SELECT DISTINCT t2.id, t2.name FROM user_group t1 LEFT JOIN department_info t2 ON t1.dept_id = t2.id WHERE t2.`status` != -1 AND t1.is_del = 1 and t1.group_id = #{groupId}

WITH RECURSIVE department_tree AS (SELECT id, name, parent_id FROM department_info WHERE id IN (SELECT dept_id FROM user_group WHERE is_del = 1 and group_id = #{groupId} AND user_group.dept_id IS NOT NULL) AND status != -1 UNION ALL SELECT d.id, d.name, d.parent_id FROM department_info d INNER JOIN department_tree dt ON d.parent_id = dt.id WHERE status != -1 ) SELECT distinct t2.* FROM department_tree t1 LEFT JOIN user_info t2 ON t1.id = t2.dept_id WHERE t2.id IS NOT NULL UNION SELECT DISTINCT t4.* FROM user_group t3 LEFT JOIN user_info t4 ON t3.user_id = t4.id WHERE t3.dept_id IS NULL AND t3.group_id = #{groupId}
